name: Advanced Expense Tracker (Python Desktop Application)
bullets: Architected a modular \textbf{Python application} for individual and group expenses with secure login, applying \textbf{OOP principles} and \textbf{MVC \& DAO design patterns} over \textbf{SQLite3}.
Implemented concurrent transaction handling and real-time cost splitting using \textbf{Python threading} and locks for thread-safe DB writes; visualized spending trends with \textbf{Matplotlib}.

name: Hospital Management System (Full-Stack Application)
stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, SageMaker, Hugging Face
bullets: Built a \textbf{full-stack healthcare platform} (React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB) managing appointments, patient records, lab reports, and medical history with \textbf{role-based access control}.
Fine-tuned a \textbf{Hugging Face transformer-based model} reaching \textbf{88\% accuracy} for health condition prediction and deployed on \textbf{AWS SageMaker} for real-time diagnostic support.

name: InviLite
bullets: Architected a cloud-native data pipeline (Kinesis, Lambda, S3, Glue, DynamoDB) ingesting structured and unstructured enterprise data into governed ML pipelines.

Built a \textbf{RAG system} (SVM + FAISS + \textbf{Bedrock LLM}), cutting incident resolution from \textbf{1--2 hours to minutes} and lifting root-cause classification accuracy from \textbf{56\% to 92\%}.

name: RoBERTa Fine-Tuning with Custom LoRA
bullets: Architected a \textbf{parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT)} pipeline using a custom \textbf{Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)} implementation to optimize a \textbf{RoBERTa-base} model for news classification.

Optimized model efficiency by freezing pretrained weights and injecting trainable rank-decomposition matrices, reducing trainable parameters to under \textbf{1M (934K)} while achieving \textbf{83.45\%} accuracy on the private leaderboard.

Conducted extensive hyperparameter sweeps for rank ($r$) and alpha ($\alpha$) values, utilizing \textbf{AdamW} and linear decay schedulers to stabilize training under strict memory and parameter constraints.

name: High-Efficiency ResNet Image Classifier
bullets: Designed and implemented a specialized \textbf{ResNet} architecture optimized for the \textbf{CIFAR-10} dataset, adhering to a strict \textbf{5M parameter} limit for edge-ready deployment.
Enhanced model convergence and generalization by integrating the \textbf{Lookahead optimizer} and advanced data augmentation techniques, including horizontal flips and random cropping.
Developed a modular training and evaluation framework with real-time visualization via \textbf{TensorBoard}, managing checkpoints and learning rate scheduling for reproducible experimentation.

name: Flight Delay Prediction
stack: PySpark, HDFS, Random Forest, Gradient Boosted Tree
bullets: Built a scalable \textbf{PySpark ML pipeline} on HDFS to process and engineer features from over \textbf{7M flight records} using SQL-based aggregation and anomaly detection.
Performed extensive EDA to identify delay patterns; trained and optimized \textbf{Random Forest and Gradient Boosted Tree} models achieving \textbf{85\%+} accuracy.
Converted model outputs into actionable insights, enabling data-driven scheduling and operational planning for delay reduction.
